summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing initial diamond drilling results at the Proserpine target on the Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia. The release reports high-grade gold intercepts, including 95.93 g/t Au over 4.60 m, and confirms potential for open pit mining. Exploration drilling is resuming after a seasonal hiatus. This is a routine exploration update, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic processes are involved, so the filing does not qualify as a special-situations event.
